Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and the org IDs, that helps.

Short answer: we can relocate the promotional/trial credits from brightline-dev to brightline-analytics. There are two ways:
- Self-serve (recommended): customer can initiate a credit reallocation from the Billing -> Credits page if they are an org admin; steps below.
- We can initiate the transfer from our side after we validate ownership and the target org ID.

Quick checklist I need to proceed on our side if you'd like us to handle it:
1) Confirm the target org admin (you or Alan) authorizes the transfer in a reply to this thread.
2) Confirm target org ID: org_prod_77 (you already supplied this).
3) If possible, include a brief note on intended use (onboarding/demo) so I can prioritize with Ops.

If you want to try self-serve: Settings -> Billing -> Credits -> Request transfer -> enter source org (org_zz_dev_91) and destination org (org_prod_77). It will send an approval link to the destination org admins. If anything blocks, paste the approval token here and we can complete it.

Looping in Rishi from Sales to track the trial and Lauren from Billing for the transfer receipt.

I can expedite once I see authorization from your end.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
